posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Today, Wednesday the 25th of February, I will be asking Sentinels Comics related trivia questions on my twitter account every hour on the hour, starting at 10 AM CST!

For every questions that is answered correctly within ten minutes, I will post a Villains of the Multiverse story update! So, if you all are sharp, you'll keep me ridiculously busy all day - everyone wins!

I will not be cross posting the questions here, nor will I accept answers here. However, this forum thread is the perfect place for YOU to post my questions and talk about it amongst yourselves! Someone will need to tweet the correct answer to me within 10 minutes of the posted question, and I will tell you if you're correct or not! If you're wrong, no worries, as long as you still have time, you can come up with the correct answer - no limit on guesses!

So, Sentinels fans, are you ready to learn about all of these characters... and MORE?!

![|600x750](upload://a0IKoDdb8qhXdIYNfNCOXEV9PRX.jpeg)
